title: 第三章 人生初见第四章 我这未婚娘子不简单
content_zh:
远远的萧凉就听到厅堂这边传来争吵声音。
“当年我还尚在襁褓之中，你就狠心丢下母亲和我，说男儿不能死在温柔乡，要马革裹尸还，要建功立业！”
“娘亲相信了，一等就是十三年，可等回来的是你外面已经有了新欢，是一封和离书。”
“娘亲不肯接受现实，郁郁寡欢，因此病倒去世，你怕李家，怕影响自己的仕途，连看也不曾回来看过一眼。”
“这些年来，作为父亲，你可曾尽过半点父亲的责任？你可曾知道我吃了多少苦，受了多少罪，才走到今天的？”
“我病了饿了的时候，被人欺负的时候，你这个父亲又在哪里？”
“现在我长大了，把我接回来了，本以为是你良心发现，终于悔悟，记起来自己还有个女儿在老家艰苦生活。”
“可是我实在没想到，你竟然要我替嫁，替的还是那贱人的女儿。”
“苏继，你好狠毒啊，我没有你这样的爹，你不是我爹！”
“告诉你，我是不会嫁给萧凉的，要是逼我，我······我就死给你看！”
锵的一声，萧凉还在屋门之外，便感知到一股寒意袭来，抬头一看，却见一个长得十分漂亮的姑娘抽出旁边苏家人的长剑，架在了自己的脖子上。
她双眼泛红，泪水沿着脸颊滑落，透着难以形容的委屈。
这一瞬间，苏继等人皆是面色齐齐大变，整个厅堂上乱作一团。
苏继手足无措，不由猛地起身大声喊道：“女儿啊，不要冲动，不要冲动······”
萧凉目光始终都在那姑娘的身上。
她清澈明亮的眼眸似秋水盈盈，弯弯的柳叶眉，肤若凝脂，挺直的鼻梁，双唇如玫瑰花瓣娇嫩欲滴，浑然天成的清丽脱俗。
最让萧凉心动的，是那双灵动眸子间透着的勃勃英气，顾盼间皆是风情。
萧凉两世为人，见过的漂亮女子不少，譬如曾经他的未婚妻苏雨涵等等。
但是能够这般勾动萧凉心弦的，却只有眼前的这女子。
当此之际，那女子也注意到了走进来的萧凉。

霎时间，那双气韵天成的眸子猛地睁开，其间透出的震惊之色，是无以形容的。
失神时手上的长剑却是掉落在地上，发出哐当之声。
她从未见过如此好看的男子，尤其是身上那股子气息，温文儒雅中又透着几许痞气，颀长的身材，俊朗的五官全都长在她的审美点上。
最为关键的，是其一举一动，皆是让她莫名心动。
当两人目光相遇的那一瞬间，整个厅堂上已然陷入死一般的寂静之中。
片刻之后，女子咽下一口唾沫，好听的声音响起，“你是萧凉？”
她一举一动，皆是透着一股温柔，丝毫没有之前的剑拔弩张。
萧凉心间生出一种莫名的奇异之感，点了点头，“在下正是萧凉，姑娘是苏清绾？”
“是我！”女子低下头去，眉宇间有害羞之色，俏脸泛红，像是抹了胭脂似的，鲜艳欲滴。
随即又抬起头来看向苏继，正义凛然地说道：“爹爹，为了苏家，我愿意嫁给萧凉。”
content_en:
From a distance, Xiao Liang heard the sound of quarreling coming from the hall.
"Back then, when I was still an infant, you cruelly abandoned my mother and me, saying that a man could not die in Wenrou Township, and that he had to return his body wrapped in horse leather, and that he had to make great achievements!"
"Mom believed it. She waited for thirteen years, but when she came back, you already had a new love outside. It was a letter of divorce."
"My mother refused to accept the reality and was depressed, so she fell ill and died. You were afraid of the Li family and feared that it would affect your career, so you never even came back to take a look."
"Over the years, as a father, have you ever fulfilled any of your responsibilities as a father? Do you ever know how much hardship and suffering I have endured to get to where I am today?"
"When I was sick, hungry, and bullied, where was your father?"
"Now that I have grown up, you brought me back. I thought it was because of your conscience, but you finally repented and remembered that you still have a daughter living a hard life in your hometown."
"But I really didn't expect that you would ask me to marry you in your place, and you would be marrying that bitch's daughter."
"Su Ji, you are so cruel. I don't have a father like you. You are not my father!"
"Tell you, I will not marry Xiao Liang. If you force me, I...I will die in front of you!"
There was a clang, and Xiao Liang felt a chill coming while he was still outside the door. When he looked up, he saw a very beautiful girl pulling out the long sword of the Su family next to her and placing it on her neck.
Her eyes were red and tears slid down her cheeks, revealing indescribable grievance.
At this moment, the expressions of Su Ji and others all changed drastically, and the whole hall was in chaos.
Su Ji was at a loss and couldn't help but stood up suddenly and shouted: "Daughter, don't be impulsive, don't be impulsive..."
Xiao Liang's eyes were always on that girl.
Her clear and bright eyes are like autumn water, her curved eyebrows are like willow leaves, her skin is like cream, her nose is straight, her lips are as delicate as rose petals, and she is naturally beautiful and refined.
What moved Xiao Liang's heart the most was the heroic spirit in those smart eyes, which were filled with amorous feelings.
In his two lifetimes, Xiao Liang has seen many beautiful women, such as his former fiancée Su Yuhan and so on.
But the only one who could touch Xiao Liang's heartstrings like this was the woman in front of him.
At this moment, the woman also noticed Xiao Liang walking in.
In an instant, those naturally charming eyes suddenly opened, and the shock revealed in them was indescribable.
When he lost his mind, the long sword in his hand fell to the ground, making a clanging sound.
She had never seen such a good-looking man, especially his aura, gentleness and elegance with a hint of ruthlessness, his slender figure, and handsome facial features, all of which fit her aesthetic point.
The most important thing is that every move he makes makes her heart move inexplicably.
The moment the two people's eyes met, the entire hall fell into deathly silence.
After a moment, the woman swallowed her saliva and a pleasant voice sounded, "Are you Xiao Liang?"
Every move she made was filled with gentleness, without any of the tension she had before.
Xiao Liang felt an inexplicable strange feeling in his heart and nodded, "This is Xiao Liang, and the girl is Su Qingwan?"
"It's me!" The woman lowered her head, with a shy look on her eyebrows, and her pretty face turned red, as if she had applied rouge, which was so bright.
Then he raised his head and looked at Su Ji, and said righteously, "Dad, for the sake of the Su family, I am willing to marry Xiao Liang."
